chapter: Harlem, Redman's band and the Savoy
title: Waymon Carver, Chick Webb's jazz flutist
summary: Webb's band had the first jazz flutist, Waymon Carver of Atlanta, who made a record with Pete Clarke on two flutes.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He was with Chick, and going back to that band and speaking about that band, you know, Chick had the first jazz flutist.
Yes, he was out of Atlanta, wasn't he?
That's right. He went back to Atlanta to be a schoolteacher.
He was the first jazz flutist that we have ever known.
What was his name? Waymond Carver?
That's right, that's right. Then Chick made a record with him on there when him and Pete Clarke played the other flute. They used two flutes.
